pages.title: North American Sabertooth
pages.text: The North American sabertooth ($(o)Smilodon fatalis$()) is an extinct sabre-toothed cat that lived in North America and western South America during the Pleistocene, until about 10,000 years ago.$(br2)It had long, flattened upper canines and powerful, heavily built forelimbs for pinning down large prey.$(br2)Thousands of its remains have been recovered from the La Brea Tar Pits, and it is the state fossil of California.
